hypothesis: Muon helps the zero-initialized Cayley left factor align its first-order tangent, but applying Muon to the right factor destroys the learned basis through excessive subspace rotation. Left-Muon/right-AdamW should retain the direction benefit while matching the stable basis motion of the AdamW control.

causal_isolation.changed: optimizer ownership of existing Cayley factors only
causal_isolation.left_factor: Muon, one zero-weight-decay group per thin matrix, sqrt(rank) LR norm matching
causal_isolation.right_factor: the exact existing zero-weight-decay AdamW fallback and full-Cayley LR scale
fixed: training schedule and all non-Cayley optimizer groups

decision_rule.promote_if_passed: transfer the split optimizer to QK64 plus output gain at 5 TPP
decision_rule.reject_if_failed: close split Cayley-factor optimization and retain QK64 plus output gain as the attention parent
